bio: Settle down amidst our vibrant restaurant in the heart of London Victoria for a luxurious and original Afternoon Tea experience at bbar, as featured in Hot Dinner’s Best Afternoon Teas of London. Donning an array of delicious cakes and mini finger sandwiches, our selection of Afternoon Teas promise a unique and special moment.  Mini bunny chows, Amarula scones, complimented by the colourful botanical paintings and iconic black-and-white wildlife shots that adorn our walls. For a uniquely British affair, the 'Chip Shop' Fish and Chips Afternoon Tea must not be missed.  Afternoon Tea is priced from £30.00 per person, with the option of upgrading to Bottomless Prosecco Afternoon Tea for £60.00 per person for a 90-minute sitting.  Why not host your next social celebration at bbar with an Afternoon Tea Party set against the backdrop of the iconic Buckingham Palace? Whether a party of two or twenty, we will endeavour to ensure your occasion inspired fond memories for years to come.  Please note that we cannot cater to dietaries that require both gluten-free and dairy-free options. Bbar also have a 15% service charge.
